answer.reason: The verses tell of Hadadezer's defeat by David and his later war with David, which the summary does not state.

clauses.english: was defeated by David, who took his chariots, horsemen and footmen
clauses.quote: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah

clauses.english: sent for the Syrians beyond the river and was beaten again by David at Helam
clauses.quote: Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river

doubts: 1KI 11:23 mentions Hadadezer only as the lord Rezon fled from, so it was left out.
The Syrians of Damascus coming to help him (2SA 8:5) was merged into the first defeat rather than given its own clause.
